rule: every *.old.*.zig must FAIL and every *.new.*.zig must COMPILE under `zig build-exe -fno-emit-bin`; every `pack_must_contain` string must appear in section (1) of agents/packs/zig-0.16.md; every curated bullet must hit >=1 entry; where an entry has `expect`, that OLD fixture's compiler output must contain the expected error text; an entry with `since: vN` is stated only in pack variant vN and later (agents/packs/zig-0.16-vN.md), so the variants already measured keep their bytes

entries.summary: every I/O call needs an `Io`: `pub fn main(init: std.process.Init) !void { const io = init.io; ... }`, or from a plain main() `const io = std.Io.Threaded.global_single_threaded.io();`
`std.io` and `std.fs.File` are GONE — stdout is `var fw: std.Io.File.Writer = .init(.stdout(), io, &buf); const w = &fw.interface; try w.print(...); try w.flush();`
stdin by line: `var fr: std.Io.File.Reader = .init(.stdin(), io, &rb); while (try fr.interface.takeDelimiter('\n')) |line| {...}` — `readUntilDelimiterOrEof`/`readAll` are gone
`std.fs.cwd()` is gone — use `std.Io.Dir.cwd().readFileAlloc(io, path, gpa, .limited(1 << 20))` / `.writeFile(io, .{ .sub_path = p, .data = bytes })`
`std.process.argsAlloc` is gone — `const args = try init.minimal.args.toSlice(init.arena.allocator());`

`std.time.timestamp`, `std.time.milliTimestamp`, `std.time.microTimestamp`, `std.time.nanoTimestamp`, `std.time.sleep`, `std.time.Instant`, `std.time.Timer`, `std.Thread.sleep` and `std.crypto.random` are gone (std.time keeps its ns_per_s-style unit constants and std.time.epoch) — use `std.Io.Clock.now(.awake, io)`, `try io.sleep(.fromMilliseconds(5), .awake)`, `io.random(&buf)`
`std.ArrayList` is UNMANAGED now: `var l: std.ArrayList(T) = .empty; defer l.deinit(gpa); try l.append(gpa, x);` — `.init(gpa)` and `append(x)` are gone; `pop()` returns `?T`
`list.writer()` is gone — `var aw: std.Io.Writer.Allocating = .init(gpa); try aw.writer.print(...); const s = aw.written();` or `try list.print(gpa, ...)` on an ArrayList(u8)
PriorityQueue went unmanaged: `var pq: std.PriorityQueue(T, void, cmp) = .empty; try pq.push(gpa, x); const top = pq.pop();` — AutoHashMap/StringHashMap are still managed `.init(gpa)`
`std.math.abs/min/max` are gone — use the builtins `@abs(x)`, `@min(a, b)`, `@max(a, b)` (`sqrt`, `pow`, `cast`, `maxInt`, `divCeil`, `clamp` are still there)
`mem.trimRight/trimLeft` -> `trimEnd/trimStart`; `mem.tokenize/split` -> `tokenizeScalar/splitScalar`; `mem.copy/set` -> `@memcpy/@memset`; `std.sort.sort` -> `std.mem.sort`

pack_must_contain: pub fn format(self: T, w: *std.Io.Writer) std.Io.Writer.Error!void
entries.summary: `std.fmt.format(w, ..)` -> `w.print(..)`; `formatIntBuf` -> `fmt.printInt`; `fmtSliceHexLower(b)` -> `"{x}"` with the slice; a custom `format` takes `(self, w: *std.Io.Writer)` and prints with `{f}`

casts take ONE argument and read the type from context: `@intCast(x)`, `@floatFromInt(i)`, `@intFromFloat(f)`, `@intFromEnum(e)`, `@enumFromInt(n)`, `@intFromBool(b)` — the two-arg `@intToFloat`-style builtins are gone
`std.heap.GeneralPurposeAllocator` is gone — `var dbg: std.heap.DebugAllocator(.{}) = .init; const gpa = dbg.allocator();` (or `init.gpa`); `std.os.exit` -> `std.process.exit(code)`
`std.ascii.isAlpha/isSpace` -> `isAlphabetic/isWhitespace` (also `isDigit`, `isAlphanumeric`, `toLower`, `toUpper`, `eqlIgnoreCase`)

`std.Thread.spawn(.{}, worker, .{ ctx, i })`: the first argument is a SpawnConfig (`.{}` or `.{ .allocator = gpa }`), never an allocator, and the args are always a tuple, even for one value (`.{ctx}`)
`std.Thread.ResetEvent/Mutex/Condition` are gone: `var ev: std.Io.Event = .unset; ev.set(io); try ev.wait(io);` and `var m: std.Io.Mutex = .init; try m.lock(io); defer m.unlock(io);`

expect.io_arity.old.1.zig: no field or member function named 'writeAll' in 'Io.File'
expect.io_arity.old.2.zig: no field or member function named 'openFileIo'

entries.summary: `std.Io.File.stdin()/.stdout()` take no args; `f.reader(io, &buf)` / `f.writer(io, &buf)` take io first; `std.Io.File` has no `writeAll` (use `f.writeStreamingAll(io, bytes)`); there is no `openFileIo` (use `dir.openFile(io, path, .{})`)
`const std = @import("std");` (there is no `@std`); a while continue expression needs parentheses: `while (i < n) : (i += 1) {`

pack_must_contain: unused local constant/var is an error
entries.summary: zig 0.16 lint errors: delete an unused local; a `var` never mutated must be `const`; `_ = x;` after x is used is a pointless discard; `i0`, `i2`, `u8`, `f32` are primitive type names, never identifiers

`std.posix.write` is gone in 0.16 (`std.posix.read` still exists, so posix is not intact): write raw output with `try std.Io.File.stdout().writeStreamingAll(io, bytes);` (`io = init.io`), or libc `_ = std.c.write(1, bytes.ptr, bytes.len);` (needs `-lc` off macOS)
there is no `@intClz`; `@clz(v)` on a u32 returns a u6 but a u32 shift amount must be `std.math.Log2Int(u32)` (u5): `const s: std.math.Log2Int(u32) = @intCast(@clz(v)); const y = x << s;` (v != 0)
zig 0.16's std.math has no `erf`/`erfc`: write it yourself (Abramowitz & Stegun 7.1.26, abs error 1.5e-7; a series or continued fraction for tighter)
the toolchain ships a complete working 0.16 main (args, io, stdout writer) at `<zig env .lib_dir>/init/src/main.zig`: read it before grepping lib/std
